decisions.force stop: Accept for CW-18: the production RecoveryFacts/RecoveryPort is CW-19 scope (SQLite RecoveryPort, reconcile). Until then bound stop/force stays closed (fail-safe) and the user's force path is the C-D63 host-shell kill; record as a CW-19 carry-forward.
decisions.takeover during run: Accept the fail-safe for CW-18: while the user takes over the host shell during a run, automatic review is held; the UI must show it (automation.review status/reason). Routing takeover/handoff through the coordinator so reviews resume after a clean handoff is carried to CW-19/CW-16 (lifecycle reconcile).
